sections.description:
Short title extent and commencement

INDUSTRIAL STATISTICS ACT, 1942
INDUSTRIAL STATISTICS ACT, 1942
ACT No. XIX OF 1942
[For Statement of Objects and Reasons, see
Gazette of India, Part V, 7th march 1942, p. 39.]
[3rd April,
1942]
An Act to
facilitate the collection of statistics of certain kinds relating to
Industries.
1. Short title, extent and commencement.‑--- (1) This act may
be called the Industrial Statistics Act, 1942.
(2) It extends to [Subs
for the words the whole of British India by G. G. O. 4 of 1949.] [all
the Provinces and the Capital of the Federa tion).
(3) It shall come into force in a Province
on such date as the [Subs for
Provincial Government by P. O., 4 of 1975 dated 28 July 1975. Art. 2 (3).
Gaz. of Pak. Extr. Pt. I, Aug, 1975, p.435.] [appropriate Government) by
notification in the official Gazette, appoint in this behalf for such Province.

Definition

INDUSTRIAL STATISTICS ACT, 1942
INDUSTRIAL STATISTICS ACT, 1942
ACT No. XIX OF 1942
[For Statement of Objects and Reasons, see
Gazette of India, Part V, 7th march 1942, p. 39.]
[3rd April,
1942]
An Act to
facilitate the collection of statistics of certain kinds relating to
Industries.
2. Definitions.‑-- In this Act "prescribed" means
prescribed in rules made under this Act or in any form prescribed by those
rules; [Added, ibid, Aart. 2 (1) &
Sch.] (and
the "appropriate Government" means, in relation to industries the
development where of under Federal control has been declared by a Federal law
to be expedient in the public interest, the Federal Government and, in relation
to other industries, the Provincial Government).

Collection

INDUSTRIAL STATISTICS ACT, 1942
INDUSTRIAL STATISTICS ACT, 1942
ACT No. XIX OF 1942
[For Statement of Objects and Reasons, see
Gazette of India, Part V, 7th march 1942, p. 39.]
[3rd April,
1942]
An Act to
facilitate the collection of statistics of certain kinds relating to
Industries.
3. Collection of statistics.‑--- (1) The [Subs for Provincial Government by P. O.,
4 of 1975 dated 28 July 1975. Art. 2 (3). Gaz. of Pak. Extr. Pt. I, Aug, 1975,
p.435.] (appropriate Government) may, by notification in the official
Gazette; direct that statistics shall be [(a) Punjab Govt. ordered the collection of statistics on masters
stated in Sec. 3 (1) (b). vide Labour Deptt. Noti. No. 338, Lab. 55/52427 of 7
Sep. 1955, Punjab Gazette Part 1, 16 Sep, 1955, p 1065. (b) West Pakistan
Government ordered the collection, of statistics relating to matters concerning
factories in section 3 (1) (a) in areas comprising former Khairpur State,
former Sind and N.W.F.P. Province and former Bahawalpur State. Ind. Com. and
Lab. Deptt, Noti. 11/2‑3/59, May 1; 1959, Gazette of West Pak. Extr. 2
May, 1959, p. 387.]
collected relating, to any of the following matters, namely;‑
(a) any matter relating to factories,
(b) any of the following matters so far as
they relate to welfare of labour and conditions of labour, namely:‑‑
(i) prices of commodities,
(ii) attendance,
(iii) living conditions, including housing, water
supply and sanitation,
(iv) indebtedness,
(v) rents of dwelling houses,
(vi) wages and other earnings,
(vii) provident and other funds provided for
labour,
(viii) benefits and amenities provided for labour,
(ix) hours of work,
(x) employment and unemployment,
(xi) industrial and labour disputes,
and thereupon the provisions of
this Act shall apply to the collection of those statistics.
(2) In clause (a) of subsection
(1), factory means a factory as defined in clause (j) of section 2 of the
Factories Act, 1934 (XXV of 1934), or any premises deemed to be a factory in
pursuance of a declaration made under sub‑section. (1) of section 5 of
that Act:

Appointment of statistics authority

INDUSTRIAL STATISTICS ACT, 1942
INDUSTRIAL STATISTICS ACT, 1942
ACT No. XIX OF 1942

4. Appointment of statistics authority.‑--- The [Subs. for Provincial Government by P. O.
4 of 1975, s.2 (3).] [appropriate Govern ment) may appoint an officer to
be the statistics authority for the purposes of the collection of any
statistics under this Act.

Power of statistics authority to call for returns and information

INDUSTRIAL STATISTICS ACT, 1942
INDUSTRIAL STATISTICS ACT, 1942
ACT No. XIX OF 1942
[For Statement of Objects and Reasons, see
Gazette of India, Part V, 7th march 1942, p. 39.]
[3rd April,
1942]
An Act to
facilitate the collection of statistics of certain kinds relating to
Industries.
5. Power of statistics authority to call for returns and information.‑‑--
(1) The statistics authority may serve or cause‑to be served on any
person a notice requiring him to furnish, at such intervals Arid in such form
and with such particulars as may be prescribed, such information or returns
relating to any matter in respect of which statistics are to be collected and
to such authority or person and in such manner and at such times as may be
prescribed.
(2) The notice
referred to in sub‑section (1) may be served by post.

Right of access to record or documents

INDUSTRIAL STATISTICS ACT, 1942
INDUSTRIAL STATISTICS ACT, 1942
ACT No. XIX OF 1942
[For Statement of Objects and Reasons, see
Gazette of India, Part V, 7th march 1942, p. 39.]
[3rd April,
1942]
An Act to
facilitate the collection of statistics of certain kinds relating to
Industries.
6. Right of access to record or document. ‑--- The statistics
authority or any person authorized by him in writing in this behalf shall, for
the purposes of the collection of any statistics under this Act, have access to
any relevant record or document in the possession of any person required to
furnish any information or return under this Act, and may enter at any
reasonable time any premises wherein he believers such record or document to
be, and may ask any question necessary for obtaining any information required
to be furnished under this Act.

Restriction on the publication or returns and information

INDUSTRIAL STATISTICS ACT, 1942
INDUSTRIAL STATISTICS ACT, 1942
ACT No. XIX OF 1942
[For Statement of Objects and Reasons, see
Gazette of India, Part V, 7th march 1942, p. 39.]
[3rd April,
1942]
An Act to
facilitate the collection of statistics of certain kinds relating to
Industries.
7. Restriction on the publication of returns and information.‑---
(1) No individual return, and no part of an individual return, made, and no
information with respect to any particular undertaking given, for the purposes
of this Act, shall, without the previous consent in writing of the owner for
the time being of the undertaking in which the return or information was made
or given, or his authorized agent, be published in such manner as would enable
any particulars to be identified as referring to a particular undertaking.
(2) Except for
the purposes of a prosecution under this Act or under the Pakistan Penal Code
(XLV of 1860); no person not engaged in connection with the collection of
statistics under this Act shall be permitted to see any individual return or
information referred to in sub‑section (1).

Penalties

INDUSTRIAL STATISTICS ACT, 1942
INDUSTRIAL STATISTICS ACT, 1942
ACT No. XIX OF 1942
[For Statement of Objects and Reasons, see
Gazette of India, Part V, 7th march 1942, p. 39.]
[3rd April,
1942]
An Act to
facilitate the collection of statistics of certain kinds relating to
Industries.
8. Penalties.‑--- If any person required to furnish any
information or any return: --‑
(a) wilfully refuses or without lawful
excuse neglects to furnish such information or return as required under this
Act, or
(b) wilfully furnishes‑or causes to be
furnished any information or return which he knows to be false, or
(c) refuses to answer or wilfully gives a
false answer to any question necessary for obtaining any information required
to be furnished under this Act,
or if any person impedes the
right of access to relevant records and docu ments or the right of entry
conferred by section 6, he shall for each offence be punishable with fine which
may extend to [Subs. for one hundred
rupees, by Ord. 38 of 1980.] [five thousand rupees] and in the case of a
continuing offence [Subs. for to a
further fine by Act XXV of 1942. 2nd Schedule.] [with a further fine]
which may extend to two hundred rupees for each day after the first during
which the offence continues; and in respect of false information returns or
answers the offence shall be deemed to continue until true information or true
return or answer has been given or made.

sections.description:
Penalty for improper disclosure of information or returns

INDUSTRIAL STATISTICS ACT, 1942
INDUSTRIAL STATISTICS ACT, 1942
ACT No. XIX OF 1942
[For Statement of Objects and Reasons, see
Gazette of India, Part V, 7th march 1942, p. 39.]
[3rd April,
1942]
An Act to
facilitate the collection of statistics of certain kinds relating to
Industries.
9. Penalty for improper disclosure of information or returns.‑---
If any person engaged in connection with collection of statistics under his Act
wilfully discloses any information or the contents of any return given or made
under this Act otherwise than in the execution of his duties under this Act or
for the purposes of the prosecution of an offence under this Act or under the
Pakistan Penal Code (XLV of 1860), he shall be punishable with imprisonment for
a term which may extend to six months, or with fine which may extend to one
thousand rupees, or with both imprisonment and fine.

4‑A. Delegation of powers and functions. [Sec. 4‑A added by West

Authority may, with the previous approval of the Provincial Government, direct
that all or any of the powers and functions to be exercised and performed by
